content:
The sector angles are \(35^\circ, 45^\circ, 55^\circ,\ldots\). If there are \(k\) sectors, then

\[
\frac{k}{2}\left(2\cdot35+10(k-1)\right)=360
\]

\[
5k(k+6)=360 \implies k(k+6)=72 \implies k=6
\]

The smallest sector \(35^\circ\) corresponds to the 7 people with one coin, so the scale is

\[
35^\circ \leftrightarrow 7 \text{ people} \quad\Rightarrow\quad 5^\circ \leftrightarrow 1 \text{ person}
\]

Thus the total number of people is

\[
\frac{360}{5}=72
\]

\[
\boxed{72}
\]
